newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets specials at 4.25 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets specials at 4.25 percent.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Wednesday conducted a round of purchase and resale agreements at 4.25 percent in the money market, traders said.
The central bank intervened to add liquidity in the market after the call loan rate traded at the top of the Bank's 3.75-4.25 percent target range, dealers said.
"Money has been tight for most of morning. It's traded anywhere from 4.0 to 4.25 (percent)," said one Toronto-based trader.
After the intervention the call loan or overnight lending rate remained bid at 4.25 percent, the trader said.
